The great quest of Yalahar: you start by fetching the Explorer Society's research notes from the newly discovered city and end up caught in the power struggle between {npc:Palimuth} and the Yalahari Azerus. Over 10 missions you gain access to the mechanisms of all the quarters, choose a side (with its own achievement) and face {creature:Azerus} in a final battle. At the end you receive the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits|Yalaharian Outfit} and choose a Yalahari piece.
The newly discovered island of Yalahar needs to be investigated thoroughly.
Level 80 for the final missions: the requirement only applies from mission 9 (the item and outfit rewards require level 80). Recommended level 120+.
Member of the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society|Explorer Society} with rank **Novice** or higher (without it {npc:Captain Max} won't talk to you).
Have completed the 3 tests of the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}.
Mission 5: have done (or bring a friend who has done) the first mission of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest} (Nibelor: Breaking the Ice), so you have access to Nibelor.
Mission 7: {item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea} to walk underwater.
5 of the 8 city items for {npc:Karith} (see the table in section 2) — optional but highly recommended
500 gp from Wyrdin on completing 'The Way to Yalahar'
Boat routes to/from Yalahar with {npc:Karith} (Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore)
Access to the district mechanisms: Alchemist, Trade, Arena, Cemetery, Sunken and Factory Quarter
One piece of your choice: {item:Yalahari Armor}, {item:Yalahari Leg Piece}, {item:Yalahari Mask} or {item:Yalahari Footwraps}
One of three achievements: **Follower of Palimuth**, **Follower of Azerus** or **Turncoat**
Boat to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay)
When you start the quest with {npc:Wyrdin} (mission *The Way to Yalahar*).
You also need the **Novice** rank of the Explorer Society. Alternatively, the password {key:whizzkid} from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (250 gp) lets you go from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}.
Direct boats between Yalahar and 8 cities ({npc:Karith})
Optional mission *Searoutes around Yalahar*: hand 5 of the 8 city items to Karith.
Mission 03 (*Death to the Deathbringer*): when you receive the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
Mission 04 (*Good to be Kingpin*): when you receive the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
Mission 05 (*Food or Fight*): when you receive the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
Mission 06 (*Frightening Fuel*): when you receive the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
Mission 07 (*A Fishy Mission*): when you receive the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
Mission 08 (*Dangerous Machinations*): when you receive the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
Requires at least Mission 03 of this quest started (to enter the centre of Yalahar).
Requires this quest completed; the side you choose in Mission 09 decides whether you get the Sage or the Villain addon.
The addon also requires the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}.
Buy 5 of the city items **before** going to Yalahar: by handing them to {npc:Karith} you unlock direct boats to 8 cities and save a lot of time and money.

From mission 3 you choose, mission by mission, between the good side ({npc:Palimuth}) and the evil side (Yalahari/Azerus). Even if you don't want to help Palimuth, always ask him {key:mission} when the Yalahari gives you a new mission — otherwise the sealed doors won't open.
If you want the **Follower of Palimuth** or **Follower of Azerus** achievement, do **all** the missions on the same side and choose that same side in mission 9.

In the missions with bosses (mission 3 and the evil side of mission 7), only the player who deals the most damage/experience to each boss gets credit. In a team, each person has to 'win' their own boss.
The final battle (mission 10) is tough and has a time limit of about 12 minutes: bring friends or stronger helpers if your level is low.
Optional, but recommended. In section 2 you will hand **5 of 8** special items to Captain {npc:Karith} to open boat routes. Buy them now, while you pass through the cities.
Buy **five** of the items in the table (it doesn't matter which — all 8 routes are unlocked anyway). Click the coordinates to see where each seller is.

The empty {item:Rum Flask} can be looted from pirates or found as a daily respawn (for example on one of the pirate ships in the Foreigner Quarter). {npc:Armenius} sells mugs of rum that you can pour into the flask.
Introductory mission of the Explorer Society. Completing it is not mandatory to continue, but it gives 500 gp.

Go to the **Ivory Towers** in Edron and talk to {npc:Wyrdin} in the centre. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He asks you to go to Yalahar to fetch the research notes of the Explorer Society representative and tells you that {npc:Captain Max}, in Liberty Bay, will take you there. The Ivory Towers are in the **eastern** part of Edron; Wyrdin is in the middle tower (the fourth), 1 floor above ground level. If you're not in Edron yet, take a boat there ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain).

Alternatively, talk to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}, west of Kazordoon, about {key:Yalahar}. Pay him **250 gold** for the password ({key:whizzkid}) and you'll be able to travel from Thais to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Bluebear}, on the Thais boat.

Go to **Liberty Bay** and talk to {npc:Captain Max}. Ask for passage to Yalahar ({key:hi}, {key:Yalahar}). Remember: you need **Novice** rank in the Explorer Society for him to talk to you. You arrive at Yalahar's harbour, **south** of the city centre. If you paid {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} for the password, you can also go from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}.

In Yalahar, look for {npc:Timothy} just north of the depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:research notes} and answer {key:yes} when he asks whether you want to help his friend {npc:Palimuth}. You receive the {item:Research Notes}.
Don't lose the notes: Wyrdin needs them to pay you.

To return to the mainland, go to Yalahar's harbour (**south** of the centre) and talk to {npc:Captain Cookie}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} (400 gp) or {key:thais} (800 gp), and {key:yes}. After you've done section 2, {npc:Karith} takes you to 8 cities for less money. To return to Yalahar, use {npc:Captain Max} again in Liberty Bay (or {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, if you have the password).
When it suits you, go back to {npc:Wyrdin} (or {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}), say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you **500 gold**. This step isn't required to continue the quest.
It isn't mandatory, but it unlocks boats from Yalahar to 8 cities, instead of depending only on Liberty Bay.
Talk to Captain {npc:Karith}, east of {npc:Captain Cookie}, in Yalahar. Say {key:hi} and {key:passage}. He refuses to open routes until you prove to him that at least 5 cities are worth it.

For each item, say the **name of the city** it comes from (for example {key:darashia}, {key:thais}, {key:carlin}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:venore}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:port hope} or {key:ankrahmun}) and answer {key:yes}. Hand in **only five**. You don't have to hand them all in at once, but it's quicker.

Say {key:passage} again: Karith now takes you to **Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Venore, Ankrahmun, Port Hope, Thais, Liberty Bay and Carlin**. Anyone who has completed the {wiki:The Postman Missions Quest} pays 10 gp less per trip.

Talk to {npc:Palimuth}, east of {npc:Timothy}, at the entrance to the city centre. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and then {key:mission} again. He marks on your map the 4 sewer points you have to repair.

Bring a {item:Crowbar} (or {item:Whacking Driller of Fate}). Most of the points are reachable through the {item:Sewer Grate|sewer grate} just **east of the depot**. One of them is only reachable through the grate far to the **northwest**, near the stairs of the Alchemist Quarter ({npc:Guide Edna} will mark it on your map if you ask her). Use the grate to go down 1 floor into the sewer.
Go to each of the 4 marked points in the sewer (1 floor down) and use the {item:Crowbar} on the controls/pipes to free them and clear the rubbish. Do this at all four.
Once you've repaired all four points, go back the same way to the grate you came down and climb up to the street again (floor 7). {npc:Palimuth} is east of {npc:Timothy}, near the depot.
You have to collect the report from the 7 guards stationed on the walls between the districts. It's a good chance to get to know Yalahar's {wiki:Quarters|quarters}.
The quarters are full of creatures. Stay on the main roads whenever possible.

The guards are inside the walls between quarters (marked on the map). To each one say {key:hi} and {key:report}; after giving you the report he lets you through to the next quarter. It's quicker to start with the **Foreigner Quarter** (southwest), but you can also start with the Magician Quarter (northeast). Recommended order: **Foreigner > Arena > Alchemist > Cemetery > Magician > Sunken > Factory > Trade**. To pass from one quarter to the next, tell the guard {key:pass} and then the name of the destination quarter. The Foreigner Quarter and the Magician Quarter have no mechanism at the gate, so you enter them directly from the centre.
With the 7 reports, go back to {npc:Palimuth}. You can leave through the **Magician Quarter**, whose gate has no mechanism. Say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.

From here on you can follow {npc:Palimuth} (good side) or the Yalahari Azerus (evil side). The difficulty is the same; the achievements change: all missions on Palimuth's side = **Follower of Palimuth**; all on Azerus's side = **Follower of Azerus**; at least one on the opposite side = **Turncoat**. The addon you can get later is decided in mission 9.
Tell {npc:Palimuth} {key:mission}. He says he left notes in the **little room on the left**. Go there, pick up the two notes ({item:History of the Augur I (Book)|History of the Augur}) and read them.
After reading the notes, say {key:mission} to Palimuth. He sends you to talk to his superior, Azerus, in the city centre, and asks you to talk to him again whenever Azerus gives you a mission.

Go to the city centre and talk to {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} (Azerus). Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He tells you to read the manifesto in the **room behind him**: pick up the two notes ({item:Manifest of the Yalahari I (Book)|Manifest of the Yalahari}) and read them.

Say {key:mission} twice to the Yalahari. He asks you to kill the **three plague bearers** in the Alchemist Quarter and bring back the alchemists' last research notes ({item:The Alchemists' Formulas}). You gain access to the **Alchemist Quarter** mechanism.
Access to the Alchemist Quarter mechanism
Go back to {npc:Palimuth} and say {key:mission}. He fears the notes will be used to turn the plague into a weapon and asks you to **burn them in an oven** and tell Azerus you didn't find them.

The Alchemist Quarter is **northwest** of the city centre. Go to the centre gate for the Alchemist Quarter and use the {wiki:Mechanism (Teleporter)|mechanism} next to the gate to pass through. If the message *"The gate mechanism won't move"* appears, you don't have access yet: first ask for the mission from the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.

Use the Alchemist Quarter mechanism and kill the three bosses: {creature:Diseased Dan} (1 floor down), {creature:Diseased Bill} and {creature:Diseased Fred}. On the way you meet {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs}, {creature:Mutated Human|Mutated Humans}, {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats}, {creature:Acid Blob|Acid Blobs}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers} and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}. Since 2012 the bosses have less health and deal less damage, and there is a shortcut to Diseased Fred.
Alchemist Quarter: location of the Diseased (image 1)
Alchemist Quarter: location of the Diseased (image 2)
Alchemist Quarter: location of the Diseased (image 3)
Alchemist Quarter: location of the Diseased (image 4)
It only counts for the player who gains the most experience on each boss. In a team, each member has to 'win' each of the three bosses (killing them several times).

Go down the stairs **northeast** of Diseased Bill and Diseased Fred and head **northwest** to the building where the papers are. Pick up {item:The Alchemists' Formulas} from the box. Beware of {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders} and {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}.
**Good side:** use the formulas on an {item:Oven|oven} to burn them — there is an oven just **west of the box**. **Evil side:** keep them to hand over to the Yalahari.
If you're going the good way, burn them right away in the oven next to the box.

Climb up the same stairs you came down to the surface of the Alchemist Quarter and go back to the gate you came in through. Use the mechanism again to return to the city centre, where the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} and {npc:Palimuth} are.

Go back to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} and say {key:mission}. When he asks whether you recovered the papers, answer {key:yes} (evil side, you hand over the formulas) or {key:no} (good side, if you burned them).
You have to go to the Trade Quarter and talk to {npc:Mr. West}, the underworld boss — either by negotiating (good side) or by threatening him (evil side).

Say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}: he wants you to force your way through Mr. West's henchmen and show him who's in charge. You gain access to the **Trade Quarter** mechanism. Then say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth}: he suggests you reach Mr. West **through the sewer, without killing anyone**.
Access to the Trade Quarter mechanism

Don't use the mechanism. Enter the sewer **northwest of the depot**, head **south** and follow the passage until you find a door. Go through the door and follow the tunnel to the end. You'll find {npc:Mr. West}: say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. Don't kill any of his men. To go back, retrace your steps: return through the tunnel and the door to the sewer and leave by the same entrance, northwest of the depot.
In the sewer there are {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}.
Evil side: through the Trade Quarter

Use the Trade Quarter mechanism and head **southwest** until you find a quest door. Climb to the top of the building and **kill at least one** of Mr. West's henchmen (for example a {creature:Smuggler} or a {creature:Bandit}). Go through another door to the **south**, where {npc:Mr. West} is, and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. The Trade Quarter is **south** of the centre, next to the harbour. To leave, go back through the same doors to the street and use the Trade Quarter mechanism again to return to the centre.
**Good side:** say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth} and then to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} (who is displeased). **Evil side:** say {key:mission} to the Yalahari.
You have to convince the druid {npc:Tamerin}, in the Arena Quarter, to breed animals: **warbeasts** for the Yalahari or **cattle** for Palimuth. Before that, he asks you for two favours.
Say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} (he wants warbeasts) — you gain access to the **Arena Quarter** mechanism. Then say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth} (he wants cattle to feed the people).
Access to the Arena Quarter mechanism

Use the Arena Quarter mechanism and look for {npc:Tamerin} (1 floor down). Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He asks you for two things: an **Animal Cure** and to get rid of the gladiator **Morik**. The Arena and Zoo Quarter is at the **west** gate of the city. To return to the centre, go back to the same gate and use the mechanism again.

Go to **Svargrond**: from Yalahar first travel to Thais, Carlin or Venore (with {npc:Karith}, if you did section 2, or with {npc:Captain Cookie} to Thais) and there take the boat to Svargrond ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). In Svargrond, go to the ice area **north/northeast** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to the island of **Nibelor**. {npc:Siflind} is on the mountain in the north of the island, 1 floor up.

Go to **Nibelor** (Ice Islands) and buy an {item:Animal Cure} from {npc:Siflind}. You can only buy it with this mission already started and with access to Nibelor (first mission of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest}). If you don't have access, ask someone who is on this same mission and has access to buy it for you.

To go back, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of Nibelor's stone circle: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you back to **Svargrond**. From there take the boat to Thais, Carlin or Venore and return to Yalahar as you did the first time ({npc:Captain Max} in Liberty Bay, or {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais with the password).
In the Arena Quarter, kill {creature:Morik the Gladiator}. He is in the **last room**, going clockwise, on the first floor. Pick up {item:Helmet (Morik)|Morik's helmet} as proof.
Handing in to Tamerin and choosing
Go back to {npc:Tamerin}. Say {key:animal cure} and {key:morik} to hand in both things, then {key:mission}. Choose: {key:cattle} (good side, Palimuth) or {key:warbeasts} (evil side, Yalahari).
**Cattle:** say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth} and then to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}. **Warbeasts:** say {key:mission} to the Yalahari.
The Yalahari wants to charge a {item:Ghost Charm} with the tormented souls of the Cemetery Quarter to use as a power source; Palimuth wants the charged amulet in order to free those souls.
Say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}: you receive a {item:Ghost Charm} and access to the **Cemetery Quarter** mechanism. Then say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth}.
Access to the Cemetery Quarter mechanism
Using the charm on the Strange Carving

Go to the **big building** in the Cemetery Quarter. At the far end of the room is the {item:Strange Carving}: use the {item:Ghost Charm} on it. The Cemetery Quarter is **north** of the centre: enter through the centre gate's mechanism to the Cemetery Quarter.

Kill the {creature:Tormented Ghost|Tormented Ghosts} that appear and use the {item:Ghost Residue} they drop on the charm. Repeat **three times** (each use makes 2 more Tormented Ghosts appear). In the end, the Ghost Charm turns into a {item:Charged Ghost Charm}. Then go back to the gate you came in through and use the mechanism again to return to the centre.
The Strange Carving room in the Cemetery Quarter

**Good side:** say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth} and hand him the charm; then say {key:mission} to the Yalahari (he doesn't believe the charm was destroyed). **Evil side:** say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} and give it back to him.

The quara of the Sunken Quarter are attacking the fishermen. The Yalahari wants the three leaders dead; Palimuth wants to know why they are so aggressive. You need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea}.
Say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} — you gain access to the **Sunken Quarter** mechanism — and then {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth}.
Access to the Sunken Quarter mechanism

The Sunken Quarter is **east** of the city centre. Go to the centre gate for the Sunken Quarter and use the mechanism to pass through. There is still land above the water, so you reach {npc:Tarak} on foot.
Talk to {npc:Tarak} and ask him for a {key:trip}. Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} (or {item:Depth Galea}) and jump into the water.
Underwater map 3 (6 floors down, last level)

Up to the 2nd level there are only {creature:Quara Constrictor|Quara Constrictors} and {creature:Quara Mantassin|Quara Mantassins}. On the last level {creature:Quara Hydromancer|Quara Hydromancers}, {creature:Quara Pincher|Quara Pinchers} and {creature:Quara Predator|Quara Predators} also appear.
Go down to {npc:Maritima} and say {key:quara}. She explains that the quara are furious because their area is being flooded with toxic sewage from the city.
Evil side: killing the three quara leaders
Kill the three quara leaders: {creature:Inky}, {creature:Splasher} and {creature:Sharptooth}. These bosses can deal quite a lot of damage.
Bring enough potions: the quara leaders hit hard and you're surrounded by quara.

To go back, swim back the same way to the surface (keep the {item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea} equipped until you're out of the water). Then return to the Sunken Quarter gate and use the mechanism again to go back to the centre.
**Good side:** say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth} and then to the Yalahari. **Evil side:** say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}.
In a factory in the Factory Quarter you have to put a pattern crystal in the control machine: the {item:Weapon Matrix Crystal} (weapons, Yalahari) or the {item:Food Matrix Crystal} (food, Palimuth).
Say {key:mission} to the {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} — you gain access to the **Factory Quarter** mechanism — and then {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth}.
Access to the Factory Quarter mechanism
The Factory Quarter is **southeast** of the city centre. Go to the centre gate for the Factory Quarter and use the mechanism to enter. All the holes in this mission are in this quarter.

Go down the hole at {coord:32877,31268,7}, go down again at {coord:32884,31267,8} and again at {coord:32887,31278,9}. Walk **north**, turn **left** and head **north** again. The {item:Food Matrix Crystal} is behind a quest door. After picking up the crystal, return to the surface the same way (bring a {item:Rope} to climb up out of the holes).
Path to the Food Matrix Crystal

Go down the hole at {coord:32936,31257,7}, go down again at {coord:32935,31247,8} and walk **east** to the {item:Weapon Matrix Crystal}. After picking up the crystal, return to the surface the same way (bring a {item:Rope} to climb up out of the holes).
Path to the Weapon Matrix Crystal

For both sides: go down the hole at {coord:32879,31268,7}, walk **north** and go through the quest door. Head to the {item:Mysterious Machine} to the **north** and use it to activate it. Then use your chosen crystal ({item:Food Matrix Crystal} or {item:Weapon Matrix Crystal}) on the machine.
The choice is final: the crystal you use decides your side in this mission.
Go back up to the surface through the same hole (use the {item:Rope}), return to the Factory Quarter gate and use the mechanism again to return to the centre, where {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} is.
Go back to {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} and say {key:mission}. If you used the Food Matrix, he is furious; say {key:mission} again and he asks you to rethink your loyalty.
It is time to choose once and for all between {npc:Palimuth} and Yalahari. From here on you need **level 80**.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Palimuth} and {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}. Both tell you that you have to decide between them.
Go to the one you want to support and say {key:mission} again. When he asks whether you want to join him, answer {key:yes}. Mission 9 is completed and you receive the corresponding achievement.
Mix of good and bad side
This choice is final and also decides which addon you can get later.
A tough battle against {creature:Azerus}. Low-level players suffer from the damage and the mana drain: bring a team or stronger helpers. There is a **time limit of about 12 minutes** to kill Azerus.

Say {key:mission} to the one you chose. **Palimuth** tells you that a circle of Yalahari wants to open a portal to demons and that the entrance to the inner sanctuary has been opened for you. **Yalahari** invites you to a 'ceremony' in the centre of the inner city and says you can pass all the doors up to the hall.

The battle room is in the central building of Yalahar (the one with {npc:Yalahari (NPC)}), **3 floors down**. With this mission active, the doors to the hall are already open for you: go down there with your team.
Enter the room. Someone who **has not yet done the quest** must click the machine in the centre of the room to start the fight.
Time limit of about 12 minutes to kill Azerus.
{creature:Azerus} appears with {creature:Rift Worm|Rift Worms}. Kill the Rift Worms and **ignore Azerus** — at this stage he is extremely hard to kill.
The battle against Azerus — notice the damage taken by the player on the left
Azerus teleports to another spot in the room and summons {creature:Rift Brood|Rift Broods}. Use **earth damage** on them and keep ignoring Azerus.
Azerus summons {creature:Rift Scythe|Rift Scythes}. Use **fire damage** on them.
Azerus summons {creature:War Golem|War Golems}. Now Azerus is much easier to hurt: **focus on Azerus** and ignore the golems until he dies.

When Azerus dies, his body turns into a {item:Magic Forcefield}. **All players** must enter the forcefield to be teleported to a room where you can see, high above, an army of rift monsters. The message *"You have a very bad feeling about this..."* appears.
After you enter the Magic Forcefield

Walk to the **northernmost point** of that room. The quest is completed for your character when the message *"It seems by defeating Azerus you have stopped this army from entering your world! Better leave this ghastly place forever."* appears.
The wiki does not document how to leave this room after the final message. Look for the exit of the room and return to the centre of Yalahar to talk to {npc:Palimuth}.
Go back to {npc:Palimuth} and say {key:mission}. You receive the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits|Yalaharian Outfit} and access to the **treasure room**.
Go to the treasure room and open **only one** chest. Starting from the **northernmost** chest, the order is the one in the table.
You can only choose one chest. Choose the item for your vocation.
One Yalahari piece of your choice
The {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits|Yalaharian Outfit} addon is obtained in the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}; the side chosen in mission 9 decides which addon you can get.
Access to the district mechanisms is gained throughout the quest (when starting missions 3 to 8), even before you reach level 80.
The wiki does not document the final dialogue on Yalahari's side; according to the wiki, the rewards are handed out by Palimuth.
